title: Credit card test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of credit-card PAN candidates paired with brand labels and Luhn verdicts. Designed to exercise the Swift triple gate (regex, Luhn, prefix) across Visa, MasterCard, Amex, Discover, JCB, and UnionPay.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one PAN candidate with its expected triple-gate verdict.

pan.description: PAN digit string, no separators. Length is 13-19 per Swift regex.

valid.description: Whether the PAN passes Luhn mod-10 and the brand prefix gate.

card_brand.description: Issuing brand, derived from the prefix dispatch in PIIDetector.hasValidCardPrefix.

rejection_reason.description: Which rule rejects this PAN, or null if valid.
